meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 剪辑出品牌片、蒙太奇、片头等各类自定义视频作品。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要灵活创作非模板化的自定义视频内容。
copy.tagline_en: Produce and edit custom video pieces, from brand reels to montages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a flexible video creation tool for original, non-templated content.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 负责较长、多场景视频的创建与编辑:先读取项目状态或需求,规划故事线与分镜,再逐场景搭画面、动画和转场,过程中加载对应规则,完成后给你可审阅的版本。
howto.when: 当没有专门流程能匹配你的请求,而你想做较长或场景多的视频(品牌宣传片、蒙太奇、静态标题等)时会触发;项目 BRIEF.md 标注 flow: companion 时也会接管。

say.text: 帮我用这几条素材剪一条30秒品牌宣传片,先出方案和分镜。
say.note: Claude 会先产出方案和分镜再开始制作。

say.text: 请把成品加快节奏,并调换第三、第五段的顺序。
say.note: 按编辑任务处理,保留原有项目决策。

say.text: 我们逐场讨论这个多场景短片,打磨每一段的动画和转场。
say.note: 可进入 companion 协作,先给完整方案再由你删改。

howto.what_en: This skill helps Claude create or edit longer, multi-scene video work: read project state, plan the story and storyboard, then assemble visuals, motion, and transitions for each scene, and show a reviewable version.
howto.when_en: It triggers when no specialized workflow fits and you want a longer or scene-heavy video (e.g., brand film, montage, static title), or when the project's BRIEF.md sets flow: companion.

say_en.text: Edit these clips into a 30-second brand film; start with a plan and storyboard.
say_en.note: Claude will give you a plan and storyboard before building.

say_en.text: Speed up the finished edit and swap scenes 3 and 5.
say_en.note: Treated as an edit, preserving existing project decisions.

say_en.text: Let's refine this multi-scene short scene by scene, reviewing animation and transitions.
say_en.note: Starts companion-style collaboration: a full design first.
